run_compute_structure_matches: run structure matching evaluation on all predicted crystal structures in a directory using CSD or pymatgen
run_evaluate_structures_file: evaluate predicted crystal structures in a parquet file against experimental references and save results
run_load_target_structures: load experimental reference crystal structures from CIF files into a dictionary keyed by refcode
run_match_structures: compare a single predicted crystal structure against experimental references using CSD or pymatgen matching
run_get_eval_config_and_method: extract evaluation configuration and method from a config dictionary for CSD or pymatgen
